description: Supply COOK (or bCOOK) to its Aera reserve to earn the supply APR. Mints share tokens (aCOOK / abCOOK) to your wallet that redeem for more of the asset as interest accrues; withdraw with `withdraw_lend`. Respects the reserve and per-wallet supply caps (refuses before signing). To use bCOOK as loan collateral call `deposit_collateral` instead — shares in the wallet do not back a loan. Simulates first. Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

amount.description: UI amount of the asset to supply, e.g. 1000

asset.description: reserve asset: `COOK` or `bCOOK` (case-insensitive), a share-token symbol (`aCOOK`), or a mint

name: lend
title: Supply to Aera
